SELECT p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE t.fullVisitorId IN (
    '2105122376016897629',
    '0047078955120420928',
    '4895430552956512702',
    '9629138648067304387',
    '039400440658825933',
    '2341448488539470965',
    '8064625150033508396',
    '6586739058236606680',
    '8430163495777040605',
    '543368443296403226',
    '049618887282998852',
    '5286653810282194817'
)
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  CASE 
    WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 AND (SELECT MAX(p.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN totals.transactions IS NULL AND (SELECT MAX(p.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p LIMIT 1) IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as session_type,
  AVG(totals.pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH inpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT 
  i.provider_id,
  i.provider_name,
  i.avg_inpatient_payment,
  o.avg_outpatient_payment,
  i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment as combined_avg_cost
FROM inpatient_avg i
JOIN outpatient_avg o ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT nppes_provider_state, SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claim_count, SUM(total_drug_cost) AS total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH l1 AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS descendant_concept_id, 141095 AS parent_snomed_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 141095 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT concept_id_2, 133834
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 133834 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT concept_id_2, 140168
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 140168 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT concept_id_2, 138502
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 138502 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
l2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cr.concept_id_2 AS descendant_concept_id, l1.parent_snomed_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
  JOIN l1 ON cr.concept_id_1 = l1.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
l3 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cr.concept_id_2 AS descendant_concept_id, l2.parent_snomed_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
  JOIN l2 ON cr.concept_id_1 = l2.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
l4 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cr.concept_id_2 AS descendant_concept_id, l3.parent_snomed_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
  JOIN l3 ON cr.concept_id_1 = l3.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
l5 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cr.concept_id_2 AS descendant_concept_id, l4.parent_snomed_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
  JOIN l4 ON cr.concept_id_1 = l4.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
all_snomed_descendants AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id, parent_snomed_id FROM l1
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT descendant_concept_id, parent_snomed_id FROM l2
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT descendant_concept_id, parent_snomed_id FROM l3
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT descendant_concept_id, parent_snomed_id FROM l4
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT descendant_concept_id, parent_snomed_id FROM l5
),
total_participants AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS total FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
),
participants_with_condition AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, s2i.icd10_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
  JOIN all_snomed_descendants asd ON co.condition_concept_id = asd.descendant_concept_id
  JOIN (
    SELECT 141095 AS parent_snomed_id, 'L70' AS icd10_code UNION ALL
    SELECT 133834, 'L20' UNION ALL
    SELECT 140168, 'L40' UNION ALL
    SELECT 138502, 'L80'
  ) s2i ON asd.parent_snomed_id = s2i.parent_snomed_id
),
condition_counts AS (
  SELECT icd10_code, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS condition_participants
  FROM participants_with_condition
  GROUP BY icd10_code
),
all_codes AS (
  SELECT 'L70' AS icd10_code UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L20' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L40' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L80'
)
SELECT 
  ac.icd10_code,
  c.concept_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(cc.condition_participants, 0), tp.total) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM all_codes ac
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` c 
  ON c.concept_code = ac.icd10_code
LEFT JOIN condition_counts cc ON cc.icd10_code = ac.icd10_code
CROSS JOIN total_participants tp

WITH monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  SUM(ABS(avg_air - avg_wetbulb) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dewp) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) + 
      ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_dewp) + ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dewp - avg_sst)) as sum_abs_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
GROUP BY year, month
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff
LIMIT 3

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' 
    AND year = '2019' 
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) != 9999.9
    AND SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) != 99.99
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wind_speed_ms
  FROM rochester_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wind_speed_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wind_speed_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wind_ma8
  FROM daily
)
SELECT
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wind_speed_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wind_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_wind
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

-- Get highest precipitation, minimum temperature, and maximum temperature
-- for the last 15 days (Dec 17-31) of each year 2013-2016
-- GHCN values are in tenths, so divide by 10.0
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value END) / 10.0 as highest_precip_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value END) / 10.0 as min_temp_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value END) / 10.0 as max_temp_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
  AND date BETWEEN PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING) || '-12-17') 
               AND PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING) || '-12-31')
  AND qflag IS NULL
  AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMAX', 'TMIN')
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH 
-- Count living trees (not dead) in 1995 by species
trees_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS tree_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE status != 'Dead'
    AND spc_latin IS NOT NULL
    AND spc_latin != 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES'
    AND spc_latin != 'PLANTING SITE'
    AND spc_latin != 'STUMP'
    AND spc_latin != 'UNKNOWN STUMP'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Count alive trees in 2015 by species
trees_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS tree_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE status = 'Alive'
    AND spc_latin IS NOT NULL
    AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Get fall colors from tree_species table
species_info AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(species_scientific_name) AS species_upper,
    fall_color
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
),
-- Combine: for each species, get the difference
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    si.species_upper,
    si.fall_color,
    COALESCE(t195.tree_count, 0) AS count_1995,
    COALESCE(t215.tree_count, 0) AS count_2015,
    COALESCE(t215.tree_count, 0) - COALESCE(t195.tree_count, 0) AS diff
  FROM species_info si
  LEFT JOIN trees_1995 t195 ON si.species_upper = t195.species_upper
  LEFT JOIN trees_2015 t215 ON si.species_upper = t215.species_upper
)
-- Group by fall color and sum the differences
SELECT 
  fall_color,
  SUM(diff) AS total_change
FROM species_diff
WHERE fall_color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY total_change DESC

WITH all_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    mta_tax,
    total_amount,
    passenger_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
    AND COALESCE(tip_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(tolls_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(mta_tax, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(fare_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(total_amount, 0) >= 0
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    mta_tax,
    total_amount,
    passenger_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
    AND COALESCE(tip_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(tolls_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(mta_tax, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(fare_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(total_amount, 0) >= 0
)
SELECT 
  pz.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  dz.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_distance, SAFE_DIVIDE(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND), 3600)) AS driving_speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 AS tip_rate_pct,
  total_amount
FROM all_trips t
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz ON t.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH cases AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN country_or_region = 'US' THEN 'United States' 
         ELSE country_or_region END AS country_name,
    SAFE_CAST(SUM(CAST(_4_20_20 AS INT64)) AS INT64) AS total_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.confirmed_cases`
  WHERE country_or_region IN ('US', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran')
  GROUP BY country_or_region
),
pop AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN country = 'Iran, Islamic Rep.' THEN 'Iran' ELSE country END AS country_name,
    SAFE_CAST(year_2018 AS INT64) AS pop_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE country IN ('United States', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran, Islamic Rep.')
)
SELECT 
  c.country_name,
  c.total_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(c.total_confirmed * 100000, p.pop_2018) AS cases_per_100k
FROM cases c
LEFT JOIN pop p ON c.country_name = p.country_name
ORDER BY c.country_name

SELECT 
  TRIM(s.county_name) as county_name,
  s.state,
  ROUND(c.median_age, 1) as median_age,
  CAST(c.total_pop AS INT64) as total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s.confirmed_cases, c.total_pop) * 100000, 1) as cases_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s.deaths, c.total_pop) * 100000, 1) as deaths_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s.deaths, s.confirmed_cases) * 100, 2) as case_fatality_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.summary` s
  ON SAFE_CAST(c.geo_id AS INT64) = SAFE_CAST(s.county_fips_code AS INT64)
WHERE c.total_pop > 50000
  AND s.date = '2020-08-27'
  AND s.county_fips_code != '00000'
ORDER BY case_fatality_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  t18.geo_id AS tract_code
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr` t15
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
  ON t15.geo_id = t18.geo_id
WHERE t15.geo_id LIKE '06%'
  AND t15.median_income IS NOT NULL
  AND t18.median_income IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (t18.median_income - t15.median_income) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    period,
    game_clock,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    event_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period, CAST(SUBSTR(game_clock, 1, INSTR(game_clock, ':') - 1) AS INT64) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(game_clock, INSTR(game_clock, ':') + 1) AS INT64) DESC) as rn
  FROM scoring_events
)
SELECT 
  period,
  game_clock,
  team_name,
  team_market,
  points_scored,
  event_description,
  SUM(CASE WHEN team_market = 'Kentucky' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS wildcats_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN team_market = 'Notre Dame' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS fighting_irish_score
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rn

WITH season_max AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(wins) as max_wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND market IS NOT NULL
    AND market != ''
  GROUP BY season
),
peak_teams AS (
  SELECT t.market, t.season, t.wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` t
  JOIN season_max s ON t.season = s.season
  WHERE t.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND t.market IS NOT NULL
    AND t.market != ''
    AND t.wins = s.max_wins
)
SELECT market as university_name, COUNT(*) as peak_performance_seasons
FROM peak_teams
GROUP BY market
ORDER BY peak_performance_seasons DESC, market
LIMIT 5

WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
kras_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS'
),
tp53_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53'
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT 
    pp.bcr_patient_barcode,
    CASE WHEN k.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_kras,
    CASE WHEN t.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients pp
  LEFT JOIN kras_mutations k ON pp.bcr_patient_barcode = k.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN tp53_mutations t ON pp.bcr_patient_barcode = t.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_status
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as no_kras_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as no_tp53_total
  FROM contingency
)
SELECT 
  SUM(
    POW(observed - expected, 2) / expected
  ) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM (
  SELECT 
    c.observed,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      CASE c.has_kras 
        WHEN 1 THEN m.kras_total ELSE m.no_kras_total END *
      CASE c.has_tp53 
        WHEN 1 THEN m.tp53_total ELSE m.no_tp53_total END,
      m.total
    ) as expected
  FROM contingency c, margins m
)

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING) as sess_id,

    traffic_source.source as source,
    traffic_source.name as name

  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE ep.key = 'ga_session_id'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'

channel_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    sess_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(name) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(name), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(name), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel_group
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT channel_group, COUNT(DISTINCT sess_id) as session_count
FROM channel_classified
GROUP BY channel_group
ORDER BY session_count DESC
